Dexterous hands: coverage & development

Robot Body Atlas v0.2.1 · Snapshot: 29 October 2026. This is a research catalogue, not a standardized independent benchmark or a procurement ranking.

The interface, filters and catalogue summaries support Chinese and English. Source-specific technical notes, manufacturer documents, papers, JSON downloads and the original performance workbook retain their original language. Translation does not change a numeric value, unit, evidence level or hardware revision.

Coverage

The first hand catalogue includes 19 model/research records from 13 manufacturers or teams: 10 Chinese and 9 international records, supported by 28 primary sources. It includes commercial, open research and prototype hands, including ETH-related work. It is a representative selection rather than a complete market census.

Metric definitions

  • Actuated / independently controlled DOF, mechanical DOF, undefined reported DOF, physical joint count and motor count are separate.
  • Check whether the wrist, forearm or external actuation box is included in mass and dimensions.
  • Fingertip force, grip force and held mass are distinct. Maximum performance in one grasp does not establish continuous capability in all grasps.
  • Standard, optional, absent and undisclosed tactile sensing are separate. Current-based estimates, force sensors, pressure arrays and vision-based touch differ.

Sources and images

All Hands Up is a model-discovery reference. Its gallery identifies AI-generated imagery; this catalogue prioritizes official product and original research images. Images retain attribution and configuration scope. Exact hardware revisions and optional tactile variants remain separate.

Next work

Expand Chinese manufacturers and research prototypes; add interface, power, flange and tactile-array details; verify wrist and external-drive boundaries; collect independent research-adoption evidence. Link hands to humanoids and arms only with explicit hardware evidence.

Maintenance

Edit research/hands/*.json and run scripts/build-hands.py. Keep metrics source-specific, preserve original conditions, and leave missing data unknown. The detailed original handoff includes the model list, source mapping and development priorities.

Read the full original Chinese handoff for the complete source-language technical record. The English page is a maintained guide, not a replacement for the original evidence.
